scores.visual_critic_note: Tol palette with rank-colored nodes and a clean search bar show real design intent, but the tree renders in only the top ~half of the viewport leaving large dead whitespace below, and the badge count labels (+37, +16) are 9px and hard to read at a glance.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree topology visualization with no quantitative axes; color encodes rank categorically, position encodes hierarchy, and circle size distinguishes parent/leaf — all honest — with the only minor robustness concern being the key function `name+depth` which could collide on same-depth duplicates rather than using a proper unique ID.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before new transitions means rapid node clicks during the 500ms expand/collapse animation cause mid-flight snapping; all other checks pass — search is debounced at 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and there are no cross-view dispatchers or stale scale closures.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure (depth-2 collapse default), +N badges for hidden descendants, 6-color rank legend, and search-with-path-highlight keep a ~200-node taxonomy legible; the only friction is that left-anchored labels on parent nodes can overlap when many siblings expand simultaneously.

proposer: 648 lines, down from 658. Consolidated the expand-all/collapse-all button handlers into a shared `setAllExpanded(bool)` function, removing the duplicated `root.each` + `update(root)` pattern. Saves 10 lines.
